stem: Which function can be used to find y, the number of gallons of fuel remaining in the tank of the semitruck after it has traveled x miles?
visual_elements: Graph titled Semitruck Fuel with x-axis labeled Number of Miles Traveled (0 to 400) and y-axis labeled Number of Gallons of Fuel Remaining (0 to 270). A line on the graph starts near 240 on y-axis when x=0 and decreases to about 180 when x=400.
